purpose: prospectively validate staged neutral/p000-first qualification and the deployment-8 break-even rule on a fresh independent Reachability workload pair before any outcome is observed

harness.profile_delivery: canonical Profile text prepended to the task prompt

reachability-p03.workload_kind: cycle-and-chord strongly connected graph, six-query batches (local path)

reachability-p04.workload_kind: same cycle-and-chord input consumed by ninety-six two-query batches (system path)

matrix.p100_follow_up: not scheduled; p000 pass stops data acquisition

staged_policy_under_test.classification: prospective replication of the post-outcome staged neutral/p000-first replay
staged_policy_under_test.stop_rule: after both repetitions of neutral and p000 on both tasks, score once with the frozen gates; do not acquire p100 and do not redispatch any cell
staged_policy_under_test.expected_profile_for_family: p000 on both tasks, based on the Luna Reachability outcome; this expectation is a prediction, not a scoring input
staged_policy_under_test.break_even_rule_under_test: the staged acquisition tokens measured here are the prospective cost of this qualification wave; combine with the measured per-deployment saving to recompute break-even deployments with evaluate_qualification_economics and compare against the replayed break-even of 8

scoring.correctness_first: both repetitions pass public tests plus frozen hidden verifier cases
scoring.performance_eligibility: task median seconds no more than 1.25x fastest correct action
scoring.cost_choice: lowest eligible median complete tokens with 5% tie
scoring.routing_space_gate: 15% saving versus best fixed eligible action on at least two tasks

failure_policy.invalid_or_incomplete_cell: cell failure; preserve and do not redispatch

provenance.primitive_lineage: target/shared/observer/api and public-test structure copied from the frozen Reachability p01/p02 workspaces; benchmark workloads, task ids, prompts, and locks are new

claim_boundary: This protocol tests whether a pre-committed neutral/p000-first acquisition policy, chosen before outcome observation, reproduces the staged qualification economics on an independent workload. It cannot validate p100 behavior and does not by itself authorize live routing.
